description.value:
Requires Attunement by a character with renown in the Ashen Verdict.

This metal band bears an oval like an eye, with a luminous turquoise stone at its center. The forge mark of Ormus the Penitent, a stylized O, is stamped inside it.

While wearing this ring, you gain the following benefits (Ashen Verdict renown required in parentheses).

Wisdom (Uncommon, Renown 3+). You can treat any 1 you roll on a die to restore Hit Points to yourself or another creature as a 2.

Greater Wisdom (Rare, Renown 10+). Whenever an effect you create restores Hit Points to one creature, you can choose another creature within 30 feet of the first; it regains half that many Hit Points (round down).

Unmatched Wisdom (Very Rare, Renown 25+). When you cast a spell with a range of Touch that doesn't require an attack roll, you can increase its range to 30 feet.

Foundry Note

For the Endless tier, turn on the effect of your spellcasting ability only.
